scope: Semantic eight-configuration study and final lexical/fusion matrix; not all historical experiments.
transformation: JSON retains decisions, rationales and numeric results. Literal evidence quotes become SHA256 digests; source paths become repository-relative. Ranked results retain top10 and reference ranks, not full corpus ranks or passage bodies. Original input hashes bind unmodified local archives. Selection revision: provisional opinion histories and repeated metric rows omitted; semantic opinions deduplicated by value and referenced by index. Full originals remain local. Exporter retained only with local archive.
